approved_iou.source: Closed-mask (3px) IoU of the approved Blender 4.2 export, measured 2026-11-03 by validate.py against the four TBR1 direction sprites.

review.note: Approved by the repo owner in batch 1 (2026-11-03).

notes: Quarter-tile prop (offsets.json: quarter-tile). Origin at the quadrant centre, z=0 at the base. Sprite anchor sits at (7,7) sim against the quadrant centre (8,8), hence sprite_y_nudge -1 plus the fitted sprite_shift [-1,1]. Lathe-turned barrel, 16 sides, painted from TBR1's own palette indices.
triangle_justification: 256 tris (6 over the 250 prop soft cap): 16-sided lathe so the barrel's round body and raised hoop rings stay smooth at quarter-tile scale; fewer sides facets the outline in views 2/3.
